title: Sustainability-Aware Discovery of Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Catalysts via a Unified Machine Learning Framework for Activity and Carbon Cost
title_zh: 通过活动和碳成本的统一机器学习框架，以可持续性意识发现双原子析氢催化剂
summary: 绿色氢催化剂的发现本身就优化了活性，将经济和环境成本推迟到使其他有希望的候选者失去资格的阶段。在这里，我们介绍了一个统一的机器学习框架，可以在单个管道中筛选催化活性和货币化碳成本。机器学习潜力可以以密度泛函理论的精度预测析氢活性和稳定性。第二个模型根据已发布的碳社会成本估计进行训练，将每位候选人的具体二氧化碳转化为货币负担。通过 23 种过渡金属和 20 种氮配位基序筛选 460 种石墨烯支撑的双原子催化剂，产生了 26 种活性、可合成的候选催化剂。然后两个轴发生冲突。
abstract: arXiv:2605.29821v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Catalyst discovery for green hydrogen has optimized activity alone, deferring economic and environmental costs to stages where they disqualify otherwise promising candidates. Here we introduce a unified machine learning framework that screens catalytic activity and monetized carbon cost in a single pipeline. A machine learning potential predicts hydrogen evolution activity and stability at density-functional-theory accuracy. A second model, trained on published estimates of the social cost of carbon, converts each candidate's embodied CO2 into a monetary burden. Screening 460 graphene-supported dual-atom catalysts across 23 transition metals and 20 nitrogen-coordination motifs yields 26 active, synthesizable candidates. The two axes then conflict. The most active candidates span Mn-, Fe-, Zr-, Cr-, Cu-, Ni-, Ti-, Nb-, V-, Pd-, Au-, and Rh-based catalysts, indistinguishable in adsorption energy yet spanning a 58,000-fold range in carbon cost. Joint optimization selects Mn2@2Nf and Zr2@2Nc, matching the best precious-metal activity at tens-of-thousands-fold lower carbon cost, independent of catalyst loading.

title: Robust high-fidelity three-qubit gates design for superconducting quantum computers via model-free reinforcement learning
title_zh: 通过无模型强化学习为超导量子计算机设计鲁棒的高保真三量子位门
summary: 多量子位门对于实现量子算法至关重要。直接实现这些门将有助于减少电路深度。然而，现有的基于模型的方法依赖于系统哈密顿量的精确表征以及控制场的执行，这对获得高保真多量子位门提出了挑战。在本文中，我们利用bang-bang控制协议和无模型强化学习，为具有可调谐/固定频率量子位的超导量子计算机实现了几种三量子位门，包括iToffoli门、奇偶校验门和CCZ门。仿真结果表明，采用Adam梯度下降优化器，每个门的保真度可以达到99.2%。
abstract: Multi-qubit gates are crucial to realizing quantum algorithms. Direct implementation of these gates will facilitate a reduction in circuit depth. However, existing model-based methods rely on precise characterization of the system Hamiltonian as well as execution of the control fields, which present challenges in obtaining high fidelity multi-qubit gates. In this paper, we exploit the bang–bang control protocol and model-free reinforcement learning to realize several kinds of three-qubit gates for superconducting quantum computers with tunable/fixed frequency qubits, including the iToffoli gate, the parity check gate and the CCZ gate. The simulation results show that the fidelity of each gate can achieve 99.2% with the Adam gradient descent optimizer. Moreover, the proposed method is robust against random noise in the control pulse. Gate fidelity can be maintained over 95% even in the case of Gaussian noise with variance of 0.3. Besides, the impacts of parameter iterative optimization strategies are also analyzed.

title: Machine Learning Hamiltonians with Polarizations for Heterogeneous Systems
title_zh: 异构系统的机器学习哈密顿量极化
summary: 机器学习哈密顿量使用局部原子结构来确定局部哈密顿矩阵元素，而无需进行自洽计算。它们已被用于研究大型系统并对其电子和光学特性进行高通量筛选。哈密顿量的预测本质上是电子静电势能的预测；然而，对于异质系统，这种势能通常由远处的特征决定，例如界面或表面偶极子，甚至纳米器件中的施加电压。因此，它不能仅由局部原子结构决定。从这个意义上说，需要使用本征原子偶极子、施加的外部势能和极化率自洽地求解电子静电势能。幸运的是，固有偶极子和极化率是局部属性，而施加的势能是规定的输入。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning Hamiltonians use local atomic structures to determine local Hamiltonian matrix elements without carrying out self-consistent calculations. They have been used to study large systems and to carry out high-throughput screening for their electronic and optical properties. The prediction of the Hamiltonian is essentially the prediction of the electron electrostatic potential energy; however, for heterogeneous systems, this potential energy is often determined by faraway features, such as interface or surface dipoles, or even an applied voltage in a nanodevice. Thus, it cannot be determined by local atomic structures alone. In this sense, one needs to solve the electron electrostatic potential energy self-consistently using intrinsic atomic dipoles, the applied external potential energy, and polarizabilities. Fortunately, the intrinsic dipoles and polarizabilities are local properties, whereas the applied potential energy is a prescribed input. In this work, we propose DeepH-Polar, a physically informed machine learning Hamiltonian model that explicitly predicts intrinsic atomic dipoles and polarizability tensors and uses them to solve the electron electrostatic potential energy self-consistently. Benchmarks on polar GaN systems and crystalline-Si/amorphous-SiO₂ interfaces demonstrate improved Hamiltonian accuracy and reproduction of thickness-dependent electrostatic variations, as well as spatially nonuniform field-induced screening that models without polarization fail to capture. Our model also allows us to study nanoscale electronic devices. By iteratively solving the Hamiltonian eigenproblem and self-consistently updating free-carrier occupations and the electrostatic potential, we simulate an 8,194-atom gated semiconductor device.

title: Machine-learning interatomic potentials for battery materials: Defect-dependent lithium adsorption and local transferability on graphene
title_zh: 电池材料的机器学习原子间电位：缺陷依赖性锂吸附和石墨烯的局部可转移性
summary: 出版日期： 2027年1月来源： Computational Materials Science ，第276卷作者： Yuhan Sun ， Xiao Huang
abstract: Publication date: January 2027 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 276 Author(s): Yuhan Sun, Xiao Huang

title: Walshness: an intrinsic neural-network representability metric for quantum states
title_zh: Walshness：量子态的内在神经网络可表示性度量
summary: 神经量子态（NQS）已经成为量子态的强大表示，在量子多体物理领域的应用迅速扩展。然而，我们对神经网络何时能够有效表示物理量子态的理解仍然有限，部分原因是 NQS 的非线性参数化、量子态复杂的符号结构以及对基选择的敏感依赖性。我们引入了 Walshness，一种量子态的复杂性度量，用于量化它是否接受紧凑的神经网络表示。我们严格证明，对于各种 NQS 架构，如果通用量子多体态具有有界 Walshness，则它承认有效的 NQS 表示，反之亦然。
abstract: arXiv:2610.00505v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neural quantum states (NQS) have emerged as powerful representations of quantum states with rapidly expanding applications across quantum many-body physics. Yet our understanding of when neural networks can efficiently represent physical quantum states remains limited, in part due to the nonlinear parameterization of NQS, the intricate sign structure of quantum states, and the sensitive dependence on basis choice. We introduce Walshness, a complexity metric of a quantum state which quantifies whether it admits a compact neural-network representation. We rigorously prove that a general quantum many-body state admits an efficient NQS representation if it has bounded Walshness, and vice versa, for various NQS architectures. We provide an algorithm for finding the optimal basis by minimizing the energy of a corresponding classical spin model. This allows us to empirically improve the learnability of various physical quantum states, including ground states of the transverse-field Ising model and mixed-field toric code, often reducing infidelity by orders of magnitude, and generalizes the basis choice given by the well-known Marshall sign rule in frustrated antiferromagnets. Our results provide an intrinsic complexity metric for quantum states with provable connections to their neural-network representability.

title: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
title_zh: 机器学习支持考虑现实世界限制的可持续合金设计
summary: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。
abstract: arXiv:2610.35946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.

title: A generative foundation model for 2D magnetized plasma turbulence
title_zh: 二维磁化等离子体湍流的生成基础模型
summary: 我们提出了一项原理验证研究，展示了自组织磁化等离子体湍流的条件生成基础模型。该模型建立在采用谱分解策略的多通道流量匹配框架之上，并针对从流体动力学到绝热参数范围内的二维修正长谷川-若谷 (MHW) 湍流的直接数值模拟进行训练。无需重新训练，这个单一模型成功地执行了三个不同的下游任务：（i）无条件生成统计上忠实的准稳态快照，恢复方向能谱和振幅统计数据，从中直接推断出统计传输量，包括湍流通量和有效扩散率及其不确定性；
abstract: arXiv:2610.36155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a proof-of-principle study demonstrating a conditional generative foundation model for self-organizing magnetized plasma turbulence. Built on a multichannel flow-matching framework with a spectral decomposition strategy, the model is trained on direct numerical simulations of 2D modified Hasegawa-Wakatani (MHW) turbulence across the hydrodynamic to adiabatic parameter range. Without retraining, this single model successfully performs three distinct downstream tasks: (i) unconditional generation of statistically faithful quasi-steady-state snapshots that recover the directional energy spectra and amplitude statistics, from which statistical transport quantities, including turbulent flux and effective diffusivity, alongside their uncertainties, are inferred directly; (ii) super-resolution from 4× and 8× downsampled observations to reconstruct fine-scale turbulence and large-scale zonal structures; and (iii) full-field inpainting from sparse spatial observations covering as little as sim 10% of the domain. The generated fields faithfully reproduce regime-dependent turbulence vs. zonal-flow states and energy partitioning. Under extreme sparsity the long-correlation zonal flows are pinned by only a handful of observations, while the residual uncertainty concentrates in the small-scale turbulent fluctuations. These results establish flow-matching generative models as powerful, unified surrogates for state generation, statistical inference, and sparse-data reconstruction, providing a scalable baseline for 3D plasma turbulence and experimental applications.

title: Data-driven synthesis of high-fidelity triaxial magnetic waveforms for quantum control
title_zh: 用于量子控制的高保真三轴磁波形的数据驱动合成
summary: 我们提出了一种用于生成任意三轴磁波形的系统，其频谱内容从直流到数十kHz，这是量子控制和自旋操纵的关键能力。为了补偿放大器线圈动态，我们采用数据驱动的方法来确定数值补偿模型。该方法使用根据要生成的特定波形进行校准的有限脉冲响应 (FIR) 滤波器来参数化系统响应。通过对已识别模型进行频域反演而设计的驱动信号的应用能够合成复杂的场序列，并在静态和单频或多频时间段之间进行急剧的过渡。实验结果验证了该工作的波形保真度和瞬态性能，从而展示了该方法的精度和可行性。
abstract: arXiv:2603.24052v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a system for generating arbitrary, triaxial magnetic waveforms with a spectral content spanning from DC to tens of kHz, a critical capability for quantum control and spin manipulation. To compensate for amplifier-coil dynamics, we implement a data-driven approach to identify a numerical compensation model. The method parametrizes the system response using a Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter calibrated on the specific waveform to be generated. The application of a driving signal designed via frequency-domain inversion of the identified model enables the synthesis of complex field sequences with sharp transitions between static and single- or multi-frequency temporal segments. The work is validated with experimental results demonstrating waveform fidelity and transient performance, thereby showcasing the precision and feasibility of the method.

title: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
title_zh: 物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则
summary: 密度泛函理论（DFT）给出了材料的电子结构，但其成本限制了大型超晶胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习的哈密顿量绕过了自洽循环，但通常是特定于系统的；通用的可以涵盖新的组合物和无序固体。此类模型必须能够推广到整个化学领域，并保持下游物理特性，同时保持大电池的廉价性。在这里，我们介绍 UniTB，一个通用的 E(3) 等变哈密顿表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at O(N) cost for N atoms, against O(Nlog N) on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.

title: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
title_zh: 用于原子能量预测的电荷密度监督实空间表示
summary: 基态电子密度包含足够的信息来确定基态能量，同时提供空间电子信息。这项研究开发了一种电荷密度信息图神经网络（以下简称 CDGNN），它从等变原子图中联合学习能量和价电子密度。这种方法将密度监督的真实空间探针表示合并到全局能量回归器中，允许与密度相关的空间信息有助于能量预测。在 QM9 数据集上，CDGNN 相对于等变 GNN 基线减少了能量预测误差，用于对较大分子进行插值和外推。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.

title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
title_zh: 作为格子规范理论的注意力：关系仅通过威尔逊环相互作用
summary: 关系通过他们共享的实体构成 - Alice 是 Bob 的母亲，Bob 是 Carol 的父亲，因此 Alice 是 Carol 的祖母 - 并且顺序很重要，因为父亲的母亲不是母亲的父亲；验证组合关系意味着关闭循环。我们证明，如果每个实体的坐标系可以独立旋转（每个实体坐标系自由度），则遵循以下三件事。在纯规格领域，不共享循环的关系根本无法相互作用。三角形唯一的规范不变分数是其完整函数 H = Tᵢⱼ Tⱼₖ Tₖᵢ 的类函数 - 威尔逊循环。
abstract: arXiv:2610.37656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy H = Tᵢⱼ Tⱼₖ Tₖᵢ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is U = Ψ(H), Tᵢⱼ with Ψ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved S₄ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.

title: Back-End-Of-Line Integration of 2-Terminal Ferroelectric Hafnia Synaptic Weights on Commercial CMOS Process
title_zh: 商用 CMOS 工艺上 2 端子铁电 Hafnia 突触权重的后端集成
summary: 用新兴材料功能化CMOS的后端（ BEOL ）是神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键途径。在这项工作中，我们首次演示了在交付的商用180纳米CMOS模具的BEOL中集成2端铁电突触重量。提出了一种新型材料堆叠，其中WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层夹在TiN和Mo电极之间。对于在450 ℃退火的器件，以低于3 ％的周期间变化实现低于1.8 V的编程。在500 ℃退火的突触重量表现出更多的渐进重量更新，而经过测试的底层NMOS晶体管在完成集成过程后仍保持功能。
abstract: arXiv:2610.37530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Functionalising the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS with emerging materials is a key route to neural network accelerators and neuromorphic systems. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time the integration of 2-terminal ferroelectric synaptic weights in the BEOL of as-delivered commercial 180 nm CMOS dies. A novel material stack is proposed, in which a WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2] bilayer is sandwiched between TiN and Mo electrodes. For devices annealed at 450 degC, programming below 1.8 V is achieved with a cycle-to-cycle variation below 3 %. Synaptic weights annealed at 500 degC exhibit more gradual weight updates, while the tested underlying NMOS transistors remain functional after the complete integration process. The trade-off between thermal budget and on-device training performance is illustrated using hardware-aware neural network simulations.

title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
title_zh: 通过高斯混合重定向和有限预算产量预测，利用现场分辨的磁矩生成磁性晶体
summary: 我们介绍 GMMag，这是一种用于生成晶体结构及其位点解析磁矩的工作流程，构建在带有图神经网络编码器和变压器解码器的条件变分自动编码器上。高斯混合采样将生成重定向到选定的化学和磁性目标，而无需重新训练。我们系统地研究编码器和解码器设计、磁矩幅度和相关符号的表示以及采样选择如何影响重建、生成质量和多样性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.37222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.

title: Magnon Super-Bloch Oscillations and Switchable Transport in Driven Magnonic Crystals
title_zh: 驱动磁子晶体中的磁子超布洛赫振荡和可切换输运
summary: 超级布洛赫振荡（SBO）提供了控制驱动晶格中波包传播的强大途径，但它们在磁波系统中的实现仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们预测了由磁各向异性场的静态和交流梯度驱动的周期性磁振子晶体中磁振子波包的 SBO。仅静态梯度就会引起具有恒定载波频率的磁振子布洛赫振荡 (BO)。值得注意的是，添加近谐振 MHz 级交流驱动会产生缓慢的大幅度包络振荡，这是 SBO 的标志。在精确谐振时，交流驱动可实现相控定向传输，载波频率偏移高达 GHz 级。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Super-Bloch oscillations (SBOs) offer a powerful route to control wave packet propagation in driven lattices, yet their realization in magnonic systems has remained elusive. Here, we predict SBOs of magnon wave packets in periodic magnonic crystals driven by static and ac gradients of magnetic anisotropy field. A static gradient alone induces magnon Bloch oscillation (BO) with a constant carrier frequency. Remarkably, adding a near-resonant MHz-scale ac driving gives rise to a slow large-amplitude envelope oscillation, the hallmark of SBO. At exact resonance, the ac driving enables phase-controlled directional transport with a carrier-frequency shift up to GHz scale. Consequently, the same structure can be switched among three distinct regimes: conventional BO, SBO, and directed transport. Analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, superperiod, drift velocity, and frequency evolution are validated by micromagnetic simulations. Extending to antiferromagnet magnonic crystals, we further demonstrate that these effects drive opposite motions of two oppositely polarized magnon modes in THz range. Our work establishes magnon SBOs as a versatile platform, opening a new avenue for reconfigurable magnonic devices.

title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
title_zh: 原子作为代理：集体预测编码的紧急订单
summary: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.

title: Cu intercalation and field-driven filament formation in vertically aligned MoS₂ memristors
title_zh: 垂直排列的 MoS2 忆阻器中的铜嵌入和场驱动细丝形成
summary: 垂直排列的 MoS2 薄膜与 Cu 顶部电极配对，已被用作电化学金属化电池忆阻器器件。忆阻开关被归因于导电丝的形成，但它们的确切结构仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们对铜嵌入、聚类和场驱动动力学进行了多尺度计算研究，以最终模拟操作条件下的细丝形成。我们使用密度泛函理论结果来微调机器学习力场，并且最重要的物理现象被进一步提炼为多粒子动力学蒙特卡罗模拟。通过对 Cu 插层结构的详尽列举，我们发现 MoS2Cu0.11 成分中最稳定的结构，其中 Cu 原子在 MoS2 层之间形成骰子晶格。
abstract: arXiv:2610.37152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vertically-aligned MoS₂ films paired with a Cu top electrode have been used as electrochemical metallization cell memristor devices. The memristive switching has been attributed to the formation of conductive filaments, yet their exact structure has remained elusive. Here we carry out a multi-scale computational study of Cu intercalation, clustering, and field-driven dynamics to eventually model the filament formation under operating conditions. We use density-functional theory results to fine-tune a machine learning force field, and the most important physical phenomena are further distilled into multi-particle kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. By exhaustive enumeration of Cu intercalated structures, we find the most stable structure at MoS₂Cu₀.₁₁ composition, with Cu atoms forming a dice lattice between the MoS₂ layers. These structures are shown to exhibit metallic character and can thus form conductive filaments under memristor operation. The simulated switching speed and threshold voltage agree well with the available experimental data. Our results give fundamental insights on the device operation mechanism and guidelines for maximizing switching speed and endurance.

title: Learning the Chronology of Materials Discovery for Synthesizability Prediction
title_zh: 了解材料发现的年表以预测可合成性
summary: 高通量计算和生成方法提出候选材料的速度远远快于合成速度，这使得确定哪些假设材料可能通过实验实现变得越来越重要。正向无标记（PU）学习已成为可合成性预测的代表性框架，但现有方法将实验报告的材料视为静态集合，忽视了材料发现的历史轨迹以及推动其进步的各种实际因素。在这里，我们介绍 ChronoSyn，这是一种时间感知机器学习模型，它通过共享的成分表示来共同学习已知材料的可合成性和相对报告顺序。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput computational and generative approaches are proposing candidate materials far faster than they can be synthesized, making it increasingly important to identify which hypothetical materials are likely to be experimentally realizable. Positive-unlabeled (PU) learning has emerged as a representative framework for synthesizability prediction, yet existing approaches treat experimentally reported materials as a static collection, overlooking the historical trajectory of materials discovery and the diverse practical factors that have driven its progress. Here we introduce ChronoSyn, a chronology-aware machine learning model that jointly learns synthesizability and the relative reporting order of known materials through a shared composition representation. Incorporating discovery chronology provides additional supervision beyond conventional synthesizability labels, improving prediction performance and enabling ChronoSyn to identify experimentally realizable compositions more effectively than baseline models. Applied to approximately 50 million hypothetical compositions, ChronoSyn identifies chemically coherent high-scoring families that include experimentally reported compositions unseen during training. These results highlight the chronology of materials discovery as an informative learning signal and suggest that the path along which known materials were discovered can point the way to those that will be discovered in the future.

title: Protonic thermoelectric effect of Superionic H₂O and magnetic field generation in Uranus and Neptune
title_zh: 超离子水的质子热电效应以及天王星和海王星的磁场产生
summary: 天王星和海王星异常磁场的起源，具有显着的倾斜和多偶极结构，对于理解冰巨星的内部结构和演化至关重要。最近的研究证实，超离子 H2O 冰具有热力学稳定性，并构成其冰幔中的主要 H2O 相。在这里，我们使用深度学习和从头算分子动力学来研究超离子 H2O 冰的热和质子输运特性。我们证明超离子 H2O 冰表现出明显的质子热电效应，在天王星内部的最大塞贝克系数可以达到 sim 620 μV K⁻1，而海王星的塞贝克系数较低，在 570-585 μV K⁻1 范围内。
abstract: arXiv:2601.03659v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The origin of the anomalous magnetic fields of Uranus and Neptune, with significant tilts and multi-dipole configurations, is central to understanding the internal structure and evolution of the ice giants. Recent investigations confirmed that superionic H₂O ice is thermodynamically stable and constitutes the dominant H₂O phase within their icy mantles. Here, we use deep learning and ab initio molecular dynamics to investigate the thermal and protonic transport properties of superionic H₂O ice. We demonstrate that superionic H₂O ice exhibits a pronounced protonic thermoelectric effect, with a maximum Seebeck coefficient that can reach sim 620 μV K⁻¹ within the interior of Uranus, whereas Neptune's is lower, within the range of 570-585 μV K⁻¹. Consequently, the temperature gradients in the icy mantles can induce proton migration, thereby driving magnetic field generation. Based on this mechanism, and within a dipolar approximation that captures the mean field, the disparities in mean dipolar magnetic field strength between Uranus and Neptune can be explained exclusively by their differing internal temperature gradients, and the predicted mean field strengths are comparable to those observed by Voyager 2.

title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
title_zh: 环面上任意子的连续神经波函数
summary: 拓扑有序相中的移动任意子提供了一个研究分数交换统计如何在有限密度下塑造集体行为的环境。我们介绍 AnyFormer：环面上连续任意子的神经变分框架，它明确地结合了统计相互作用和全局缠绕约束。我们构建了一个平滑的轨道框架，强制执行矩阵值环面边界条件，并用提供常规碰撞行为的解析对因子对其进行补充。通过变分蒙特卡罗并行优化轨道几何结构和多体振幅。我们将 AnyFormer 应用于没有外部场或相互作用势的半子，隔离仅由统计生成的独特相关性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for N = 4 and 6 semions. Scaling up to N = 16 semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For N = 12 and 16 semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.

title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
title_zh: 压力下固体氧晶格耦合强相关模型的基态特性
summary: 固体氧是一种S=1分子磁体，自旋自由度和晶格自由度之间具有强耦合。最近的研究表明，磁矩在压力下与四聚体扭曲共存。我们从具有自旋轨道耦合的双轨道 Peierls--Hubbard 模型导出了有效的自旋哈密顿量。所得模型包含相互竞争的易平面单离子和易轴交换各向异性。我们使用量子蒙特卡罗模拟在方形晶格上分析该模型，并评估包括四聚体模式在内的几种晶格畸变模式的磁力对晶格刚度的贡献。我们发现，在整个研究的参数范围内，四聚体模式是所考虑的畸变模式中最有利的。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid oxygen is an S=1 molecular magnet with strong coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom. Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure. We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. The resulting model contains competing easy-plane single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies. We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern. We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied. Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.
